name: filebot-pro-promo
description: Promotional video for FileBot Pro (English and Spanish), built with Remotion

scripts.render:posters: remotion still promo-en-720p ../public/video/filebot-pro-en.jpg --frame=250 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=85 && remotion still promo-es-720p ../public/video/filebot-pro-es.jpg --frame=250 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=85
scripts.render:720p: remotion render promo-en-720p out/filebot-pro-promo-en-720p.mp4 --crf=20 --audio-bitrate=128k && remotion render promo-es-720p out/filebot-pro-promo-es-720p.mp4 --crf=20 --audio-bitrate=128k
scripts.render: npm run music && npm run render:en && npm run render:es && npm run render:posters
